videos.desc: A young woman in a white summer playsuit sits on the edge of a bed typing on her phone with both thumbs and grinning at the screen. She carries on reading and typing standing in a bright kitchen, laughing at what she reads. Back in the bedroom she sits cross legged on the bed holding the phone and beaming into the camera, then throws herself backwards onto the covers kicking her legs in the air, and finally pulls the white duvet right over herself so only a foot sticks out.

A dark room where someone is pressed behind a heavy beige curtain with only a hand showing at the gap. Cut to an office, where a grinning man in a blue polo shirt is folded up under a desk with his arms round his knees. Then a small boy in a red shirt presses himself against a wide tree trunk in a park and peers round it with wide eyes. A quiet living room with an empty fireplace swings past, and finally a whole group of people leap up from behind a sofa with their arms in the air as confetti falls.

On a city square a small group of friends huddles in a tight group hug with their arms around each other; passers-by walk over and wrap their arms around the outside, and more and more people keep attaching themselves until a large mass of people is pressed into one huge hug.
videos.said: Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes!

videos.desc: A young man in a waistcoat and shirt opens the door of his flat and waves people in. He gathers their coats in his arms and hangs them on hooks in the hall. In the kitchen he slides two tall glasses of sparkling water across the counter towards the camera. At a candlelit table set with pasta, salad, bread and wine, the guests laugh together; he stands at the head of the table and lifts his glass to them.

A young woman in an oversized beige sweater stands on a city pavement beside a pastel coffee kiosk, looking down at her phone. She glances up at a man in a denim jacket and her face opens in recognition; both of them point at each other and start talking. They shake hands warmly next to the kiosk window, then stand facing each other holding takeaway coffee cups and carry on chatting.

A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks away from the camera across a car park towards a modern hospital with a red cross sign, carrying tulips and a round balloon, with an ambulance parked at the side. She goes through the sliding glass doors, along a long white corridor past open ward doors, and pushes open the door of a patient room. Inside, a young woman in a hospital gown is sitting up in bed; she claps her hands and beams when she sees the flowers and the balloon.

A woman in a chunky cream jumper paddles a red canoe straight toward the camera across a huge, glassy blue lake. The drone pulls back and up and she is the only person on the water. She reaches a tiny rock island with a single pine tree on it, steps out and stands there by herself, the whole scene mirrored in the still water.

At a Paris cafe two young women in coats lean in close over a marble bistro table holding two cappuccinos. Then an elderly couple at a cafe table hold each other's faces and kiss. Next a young couple kisses in front of the Eiffel Tower, the man leaning the woman backwards, and they end in a long hug on the pavement while cafe guests watch.

In a university lecture room a student with bright blue hair looks at something on his phone and starts laughing. The classmates around him crack up too, one throwing his head back, until the whole room is roaring. Then a teacher walks in and stands at the whiteboard, the class sits back down at their laptops, and one boy is left lying on the floor between the desks still shaking.

A montage of people taking in sounds. A young man in a sunlit room wears big over-ear headphones, eyes closed and smiling as music plays. Two women sit over coffee in a cafe, one talking with her hand at her temple while the other leans in towards her. A man in a blue shirt presses the side of his face and a cupped hand against a closed office door in a corridor, eyes wide. Finally a festival crowd stands in front of a lit stage at dusk, some of them pressing their hands over their ears.
videos.said: God, save that for the camera.

videos.desc: A wedding ceremony on a beach under a white rose arch, with the sea and cliffs behind. The bride, in a long white dress and a veil, slides a ring onto the groom's finger while he smiles down at her. He then takes her face in his hands and they kiss; the seated guests stand and applaud, and the two hold hands and laugh together under the arch.

A woman in an orange blazer walks into a bright open-plan office on her first day, carrying a cardboard box of desk things. One colleague after another steps up to shake her hand while she balances the box on one arm, and at the end the whole team stands around her, smiling and applauding as she shakes yet another hand.
videos.said: Hi there, nice to meet you. Welcome aboard!

videos.desc: A young man with a backpack holds his card against the reader at a gym turnstile; a green tick lights up and he walks through into the gym. The clip cuts to a library chess club, where a smiling elderly woman arrives at a table of chess boards, sits down, and the other players wave, make a move on the board and applaud her as one of them.

Three hikers with big backpacks stand at a wooden railing on the rim of the Grand Canyon under a clear blue sky. One after another they cup their hands round their mouths and yell out over the canyon with their mouths wide open, then all three yell together with their arms flung out towards the drop.

A boy and a girl run through a living room, then whisper and laugh together under a white sheet stretched into a den. At a table they both grip the same chocolate-chip cookie and pull, faces screwed up, until it breaks into two halves and each keeps one. The clip ends in a sunny back garden where a big group of children run across the grass and then flop down in one laughing pile.

Two teenagers in a bedroom hold up a sparkly silver top and laugh, then lean into the camera and blow a kiss. One sits behind the other on the bed and plaits her hair. The clip cuts to a living room where about fifteen girls are packed onto a sofa and the floor, all shouting and laughing at the camera at the same time.

A young woman in a red blazer stands on a low wooden platform in a European city square and speaks into a microphone on a stand. A crowd presses around her, many of them filming with their phones. She gestures with one arm while she talks, then raises her fist and the crowd claps.

On a wet London street a young woman's sheets of paper are scattered across the road; a young man kneels down, gathers them up and hands them back, and she smiles at him. Later, at a bus stop in the rain, an older man in a suit holds his umbrella over her head and points out the right bus. A red double-decker pulls in, and as she steps aboard she turns back, waves and thanks him while he keeps the umbrella up.

Four short scenes of people speaking with each other. A man in a hoodie walks along a busy New York street with a phone at his ear, answering and gesturing with his free hand. Two women in a cafe lean towards each other over their cappuccinos, one telling something and the other reacting with wide eyes. An elderly woman and a middle-aged man stand on either side of a white picket fence in a sunny front garden and lean in to talk across it. Finally a family around a lit dinner table talk over each other, pointing and laughing.

At a long cafe table on a sunlit Italian piazza, a grey-haired woman in glasses turns to the young man beside her and makes a point with both hands while he answers her back. More friends arrive and sit down along the same table of espresso cups and water glasses, and each of them joins in, leaning forward, putting a view to the others and answering what is said, until the whole table is turned in towards the middle, gesturing and laughing.
videos.said: No way! No way! No way! Is that so?

videos.desc: A young woman with a long red braid and a young man carrying a pink and blue box walk up to a small blue wooden cottage buried in hanging flowers. The bright blue door opens and an old woman in a headscarf leans out, beaming at them; she comes onto the step and the two young people wrap her in a hug. Inside the low wooden kitchen they lift a cream cake out of its box onto a small table beside a jar of sunflowers, the young woman pours from a white kettle into enamel mugs, and all three lean over the cake together, laughing.

In a grand old library reading room with green banker's lamps and tall bookshelves, a student in a shirt and striped tie leans across the long table, cups his hand around his mouth and passes something on to the next person. One after another the students at the table turn sideways, listen, react with wide eyes and a smirk, and pass it along the row. The last shot shows the whole row of students leaning in and giggling over their open books.

Outdoors at sunset on a street basketball court beside a graffiti wall. A girl in a tie-dye set dances and dribbles a basketball while the friends around her clap and dance with her; the camera pulls back and the gathering keeps growing until a huge crowd fills the whole street, everyone dancing with their arms in the air, while a skateboarder rolls through the middle.

On a snowy cobbled street of colourful old houses beneath a forested hill on a bright winter day, a young man in a red wool jacket stands with a snow shovel after clearing the pavement, with heaps of snow along the road. From her doorstep a young woman with a dark braid, in a navy puffer jacket, hands him a glass of hot tea and presses her other hand to her chest in thanks. He takes the glass and drinks. A dachshund in a yellow knitted jumper sits on the step and a mint-green car is parked behind.

In a dim bar with a small stage, purple and blue stage lights and haze, a young man in a black vest sings loudly into a microphone on a stand with his head thrown back and eyes shut. Next to the stage a young woman in a silver sequined top and black skirt squeezes her eyes shut and covers both ears with her hands. A shaggy grey dog sits on the rug and howls up at him. The view moves closer to the three of them. A stool with a tambourine, a velvet sofa, a lamp and people with drinks fill the room.

On a city street at night in the rain, in front of a noodle shop window and a glowing neon restaurant sign, a laughing young woman in a red coat jumps into the arms of a young man in a black jumper and jeans. He holds her tight and spins her round, then sets her down. He takes her face in his hands, they smile at each other, and they rest their foreheads together, their hair wet from the rain. The wet pavement reflects pink and blue light.

In an empty roller-skating hall after a party, a young man in a blue padded vest, white T-shirt and black trousers smiles as he pushes a wide broom through a big pile of pink, gold and silver confetti and burst balloons on the wooden floor. Pink and silver balloons lie scattered around. Behind him a young blonde woman in a lilac top sits on a bench taking off her white roller skates and then stands up. A mirror disco ball hangs from the black ceiling, and pink and teal neon lights glow on the walls.

On a rooftop terrace in the evening, two young women who look almost exactly the same stand side by side, laughing and pointing at each other: both have long dark wavy hair, gold hoop earrings, dark green satin slip dresses and gold sandals. They lean together laughing, then turn to each other and hug. String lights hang overhead. Around them are a wicker daybed with patterned cushions, a carved wooden door, a green balustrade and patterned tiles, with city towers under a deep blue sky.

A wooden platform high in a rainforest tree at sunset. A young woman in a red dress, a white helmet and a climbing harness swings in on a zip line, lands on the platform and holds out a sunflower to a young man in a white shirt and beige trousers, who laughs and takes it. A table with a white cloth, a candle and glasses is set for two. A waiter holds a menu, a guide in black stands by the rope, two toucans land on the line, and paper lanterns hang above a misty waterfall.

A house party in a small kitchen. A young woman in a denim jacket and a black dress sticks out her tongue as she holds a small silver digital camera at arm's length, its flash firing, taking a selfie with friends who pull faces beside her. Then she lowers the camera and they all crowd round to look at its screen, laughing. A pizza box, a bowl of crisps, bottles and cans stand on the counter. Balloons are stuck on the fridge, fairy lights hang along the cupboards and people dance in the doorway.

An old stone lighthouse stands on black rocks in a storm, under grey clouds with a gap of golden light on the horizon. On the railed balcony at the top, a young couple in matching yellow raincoats hold each other close and kiss, while a huge white wave crashes up against the tower below them and then falls back, leaving water pouring off the rocks. Inside the glass lantern room behind them, a man watches beside the glowing lamp. Seagulls fly around the tower over the rough sea.

Inside a warm, old-fashioned bar. A man with short brown hair and a cream linen shirt lifts a bulldog in a striped knitted jumper from the bar edge and sets it down carefully on a round wooden bar stool, where it stands calmly. He lets go, steps back and gestures towards the dog. A newspaper and a set of keys lie on the marble counter beside a brass rail. Shelves of bottles glow behind the bar, a bartender works in the background, and other customers talk further along.

In a dark wood-panelled bistro in the evening, a young woman in a white satin dress and a young man in a cream suit sit at a small marble table, lean their heads together and laugh. Together they cut a small white cake decorated with sugar roses with one knife and then lift the knife up, smiling at each other. Glasses of sparkling wine, a candle, a vase of pink roses, a wrapped gift and a bunch of dried flowers stand on the table, and a rainy street glows through the window.

A hallway with blue walls and a patterned tiled floor. A young woman in a blue shirt and wide black trousers stands by the open front door with a travel bag and points casually through a doorway. In the bathroom behind it a large white swan stands in the roll-top bath. A young man in a green T-shirt sits on the arm of a sofa tying his shoe. The woman then lifts her bag, turns and walks out of the front door. Coats hang on hooks and botanical prints hang on the wall.

A young couple on a stone riverside bridge in Rome at sunset, with a great domed church on the skyline. The railing is covered in dozens of colourful padlocks. A young man in a white shirt throws a small key high into the air over the river, while a young woman in a lilac dress laughs and holds a padlock locked on the railing. He lowers his arm, and the two turn to each other and smile. A seagull stands on the wall and street lamps line the bridge.

A selfie at an outdoor music festival at sunset. Two young women press their cheeks together and laugh with wide open mouths: one with long braids in a blue crop top, the other with curly hair in a yellow halter top. Colourful confetti swirls in the sky, the stage behind glows with coloured lights, and the crowd dances around them, one young man sitting on a friend's shoulders with his fist up, and a straw hat flies into the air. The sky is streaked pink and orange.

A selfie in a park in spring after rain. A smiling young woman with long dark hair in a lilac top and white pleated skirt holds the phone at arm's length. Behind her a young man in a white T-shirt holds his denim jacket over her head like a roof and kisses her gently on the cheek, then smiles at her as she laughs. Pink cherry blossom petals drift through the air from a flowering tree, puddles shine on the path, and other people sit and play on the grass behind them.

A warmly lit flat as the evening begins, the sky outside the window deep purple with city lights coming on. A smiling young man with a short beard in a shiny royal blue shirt over a white T-shirt and cream trousers takes a mirror selfie, straightens his collar and poses, dressed to go out. Behind him by the open door another young man crouches to tie his shoes, then stands up and waits. A glass pendant lamp glows over a wooden cabinet with a plant and a bottle of scent.

A sunny living room the morning after a party. A young woman with messy hair and pink pyjamas sits on a yellow sofa, laughing as she holds up a gold paper crown and a balloon, then looks at the crown and throws her arms up with a shout. Balloons, streamers and confetti are scattered over the parquet floor, and a round cake sits on the coffee table. A ginger cat curls up on a cushion, and behind the sofa a young man in a cream T-shirt pulls down a long streamer to tidy up.

A knife cuts into a round chocolate cake with a single burning gold candle. A young woman in a brown leather jacket is cutting it at a wooden counter, and a young man in a navy jacket stands close beside her. Two full champagne glasses stand next to the cake, and city lights shine through a rainy window at night. They laugh and look at each other, then he puts his arm around her and they kiss. The one candle shows that it is their first anniversary: one year together.
